canonicalFlow.diagram: GARMENT PHOTOS -> GARMENT/01-04 -> FACE PASS -> BODY PASS -> PRE-ROOM SUBJECT LOCK -> STYLING -> ROOM ATTACH -> 05 -> (06 || 07)
canonicalFlow.rule: The garment set is established and 01-04 accepted before model work. View 03 is garment-presentation-only and may never control Lulu identity or body; if generic mannequin geometry harms transfer, an anonymous Lulu-proportioned garment-transfer form must be controlled by the body canon. FACE is a dedicated operation drawing from the complete real-photo authority stack plus approved translation guidance. BODY is a separate operation that must use the accepted FACE candidate as identity parent and preserve it. A complete neutral-staged pre-room subject render must then be accepted and rebased as the garment-specific SUBJECT_LOCK or bounded SUBJECT_CORE_LOCK. ROOM/05 attaches the exact locked atelier to that subject without regenerating identity, body, garment, hair or pose; only an explicitly deferred accessory may change. Before every 005, a current official Fashion Nova page must be checked and recorded privately as advisory footwear/accessory direction only; it never controls garment provenance, identity, body or room. Hair stays unchanged unless explicitly restyled. 006 and 007 inherit accepted 005 styling, are independent siblings from accepted 005 and never parent one another. Every 006 operation must include the dedicated side canon and every 007 operation the dedicated back canon, together with direct real-Lulu angle evidence. Every 005/006/007 requires a pre-invocation render-quality contract and separate post-generation realism/texture review. The final gate is realistic full-body Lulu likeness, body balance, attitude, presence, pose, garment truth, natural skin/material texture and believable scene integration.

garment.rule: The exact reviewed 01-07 sets for Garments 009 through 016, Garment 018 and Garment 019 are privately locked. G017 views 01-04 are privately locked from direct front and rear evidence; its 02 is direct-rear-supported presentation and its 04 is model-completed presentation only. Each accepted 01 controls its garment-specific holistic subject synthesis. Direct captures retain construction truth. Each accepted 05 may parent only its own independent 06 and 07 siblings. Rejected candidates never parent.

identity.rule: Every FACE operation must use the complete independent authority stack together: verified F01-F10 multi-angle contact sheet, recovered raw frontal close-up, recovered raw open-eye three-quarter photograph, real-photo frontal face lock, and user-approved generated V4 translation lock. The active full operation board packages F01-F10 plus the exact open-eye and frontal PNG copies into one private reference so none is omitted at the five-image tool boundary; it is not new evidence. The generated lock supplies repeatable geometry but never replaces or outranks the real-photo layers. Accepted 001/05 and 004/05 are translation guidance only. Hair stays unchanged from the accepted V4 styling unless the user explicitly restyles it.

body.rule: Real Lulu photos remain body evidence truth. The V4 source and three-view plate are user-approved modeled silhouette and garment-transfer controls, not verified measurements. Use the direct angle contacts, including the gym rear-profile evidence where relevant, and the combined plate to preserve Lulu's believable bust-waist-hip balance, rear projection, waist-to-upper-thigh continuity, thighs, legs and heel-aware stature as one complete body rather than optimizing isolated measurements. Accepted G004/05-07 are secondary JUW body-translation continuity only: use 05 for full-height stature and front waist-to-hip balance, 06 for soft-left-profile waist and side/rear projection, and 07 for right-rear-three-quarter waist-to-hip continuity and rear projection. They never control face or another garment and must be normalized for fabric stiffness, heels, pose, camera and perspective. Do not compress or exaggerate the evidence-supported rear silhouette.

renderQuality.requiredBeforeGatePass: Every named renderQualityReview field must equal PASS; a combined anatomy/atelier summary is insufficient.
renderQuality.rule: Texture means source-supported material behaviour and natural skin detail, not added grain. Reject waxy or poreless skin, invented weave, pasted texture, uniform noise, cutout halos, over-sharpening, synthetic HDR, CGI sheen, mismatched room/subject light, wide-angle distortion and non-uniform scaling.

styling.rule: Before every 05, inspect and record one current official Fashion Nova product or styling page for the same or closest proven garment family. Fashion Nova is advisory footwear/accessory styling evidence only and is never passed as a generation image reference by default. It has no authority over garment provenance or construction, Lulu identity/body, hair, pose, room, brand, camera or lighting. If no close match exists, record NO_CLOSE_MATCH and keep garment-faithful JUW styling. The user-accepted G009/05 whole-frame review closed its REPLACE decision; those accepted boots persist through its independent 06 and 07 siblings.

atelier.rule: The room is the permanent JUW setting. Preserve its icon, layout, vase, rail, garments, ottoman, rug and warm-neutral identity. Minor generative texture or lighting variance is acceptable when total realism improves; redesign or structural drift is not.

brand.rule: The wall icon is inherited from the locked room and may not be regenerated.

semanticMediaRoles.rule: Semantic role names are authoritative. Numeric slots are presentation and packet conventions only; map by role before export, database sync or Shop publication.

outputFormat.rule: One clean full-resolution image without labels, panels, text or crops. Public Shop derivatives must use scripts/virtual-atelier/export-shop-media.mjs after all seven views are accepted and locked. The exporter maps semantic roles, preserves the source with one isotropic scale, and fills the 1120x1400 canvas with a softened same-image edge extension; forced width/height stretching is prohibited.
